links.comparator_used: Other stakeholder role prompts (physician, patient) on the same cases; no unprompted, no-role baseline was tested
links.outcome: Alignment of LLM decisions with physician panel majority in cases with clear consensus
links.effect: Insurer role reduced alignment with physician majority by 50% for GPT-5.4 (p = 0.004), 45% for Gemini 3.1 Pro (p = 0.008) and 10.5% (NS) for Opus 4.6
links.tradeoff: Insurer role shifted primary ethical values from beneficence (27%) to financial stewardship (20%) across all LLMs, with systematic denial of physician-endorsed, patient-preferred treatments
links.quote: Among 20 cases with clear physician consensus, LLMs prompted as an insurer reduced alignment with physician majority by 50% for GPT-5.4 (p = 0.004), 45% for Gemini 3.1 Pro (p = 0.008) and 10.5% (NS) for Opus 4.6.
